description: q1 check of the Na relabelling protocol (docs/na-relabel.md, ADR-0016; reading rule fixed there 2026-11-25). 12 train-split interface-1np frames drawn in 4 strata; settings q9-c700 (reproduction check on the first EQ and TS frames), q9-c2000 (reference), q1-c700 (protocol), q1-c2000 (control). Every setting restarts each frame from a seed with the full U, as the longa and event labels did (base input: the first drawn frame's relabel.inp); the q1 seed is one single point of the first drawn frame with the interface_aimd label protocol (seed_protocol_dir: SCF_GUESS ATOMIC, U ramping 0.5 eV each SCF) and Na q1 at 700/70. Layout 96 MPI x 1 thread on n12: the legacy interface labels (GLOBAL| lines of their relabel.out; launched by ~/prussian-blue/cubo/dataset/roda_fila_rotulos.sh). Wall times: agent's estimates from the legacy timings and the v2 ratios (x3.8 at 2000 Ry, x1.2 for q1); a job cut by its wall time resumes when resubmitted.

slurm.layout_source: legacy interface-1np labels: 96 MPI x 1 thread (GLOBAL| lines of eventos/interface-1np/*/rotulos/j*/relabel.out and interface-1np-new/longa/rotulos/b*/relabel.out), launched on n12 by ~/prussian-blue/cubo/dataset/roda_fila_rotulos.sh
